memories.text: The preferred code editor is Visual Studio Code.
The weekly planning meeting happens on Monday morning.
Financial reports use United States dollars.
Application logs are retained for fourteen days.
Security changes require review by two maintainers.
The primary deployment region is Frankfurt.
Research summaries are delivered as Markdown documents.
Routine notifications are sent by electronic mail.
Protected changes merge into the main branch.
The analytics dashboard owner is Elena.
